results.question: What were total sales across the whole dataset?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ft.sales_value), 2) AS total_sales FROM retail.fact_transactions AS ft LIMIT 100

results.question: How many shopping trips were made in total?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT basket_id) AS total_trips FROM retail.fact_transactions WHERE week BETWEEN 1 AND 53 LIMIT 100

results.question: How many households redeemed at least one coupon?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT household_id) AS num_households FROM retail.fact_coupon_redemption LIMIT 100

results.question: Which 5 departments had the highest sales?
results.sql: SELECT dp.department, ROUND(SUM(ft.sales_value), 2) AS sales_value FROM retail.fact_transactions AS ft LEFT JOIN retail.dim_product AS dp ON ft.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE ft.week BETWEEN 1 AND 53 GROUP BY dp.department ORDER BY sales_value DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What percentage of sales came from private label products?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN dp.brand = 'Private' THEN ft.sales_value ELSE 0 END) / SUM(ft.sales_value) * 100, 2) AS private_label_sales_percentage FROM retail.fact_transactions AS ft LEFT JOIN retail.dim_product AS dp ON ft.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE ft.week BETWEEN 1 AND 53 LIMIT 100

results.question: Which 10 product categories in the grocery department sold the most units?
results.sql: SELECT dp.product_category, SUM(ft.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM retail.fact_transactions AS ft JOIN retail.dim_product AS dp ON ft.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dp.department = 'GROCERY' AND ft.week BETWEEN 1 AND 53 GROUP BY dp.product_category ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: How many households received each type of campaign?
results.sql: SELECT d.campaign_type, COUNT(DISTINCT b.household_id) AS household_count FROM retail.dim_campaign AS d JOIN retail.bridge_campaign_household AS b ON d.campaign_id = b.campaign_id GROUP BY d.campaign_type ORDER BY household_count DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: Show weekly sales for the last 8 weeks.
results.sql: SELECT week, ROUND(SUM(sales_value), 2) AS sales FROM retail.fact_transactions WHERE week BETWEEN 46 AND 53 GROUP BY week ORDER BY week LIMIT 100

results.question: What were total sales in each month of 2017?
results.sql: SELECT t.month_name, ROUND(SUM(f.sales_value), 2) AS total_sales FROM retail.fact_transactions AS f JOIN retail.dim_date AS t ON f.transaction_date = t.date_day WHERE t.year = 2017 GROUP BY t.month_name, t.month ORDER BY t.month LIMIT 100

results.question: How many shopping trips happened on weekends versus weekdays?
results.sql: WITH trip_counts AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT basket_id) AS trips, CASE WHEN dim_date.is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type FROM retail.fact_transactions JOIN retail.dim_date ON fact_transactions.transaction_date = dim_date.date_day GROUP BY day_type) SELECT * FROM trip_counts LIMIT 100

results.question: What were sales by quarter in 2017?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ft.sales_value), 2) AS sales_value, dd.quarter FROM retail.fact_transactions AS ft JOIN retail.dim_date AS dd ON ft.transaction_date = dd.date_day WHERE dd.year = 2017 GROUP BY dd.quarter ORDER BY dd.quarter LIMIT 100

results.question: What is the average basket value?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(sales_value), 2) AS avg_basket_value FROM (SELECT basket_id, SUM(sales_value) AS sales_value FROM retail.fact_transactions GROUP BY basket_id) LIMIT 100

results.question: What is the average basket value for each income band?

results.question: What percentage of purchasing households have demographic data?

results.question: How many products were featured on the front page of the mailer in week 10?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.product_id) AS product_count FROM retail.fact_promotion AS fp WHERE fp.week = 10 AND fp.mailer_location = 'D' LIMIT 100
